top_concerns: Marginal novelty: relevance top-k plus DivPrune-style greedy diversity; no comparison with other prompt-aware or standard pruning methods (FastV, SparseVLM, VisionZip, PAR, GlimpsePrune)
Gains over DivPrune are negligible or mixed; Table 2 shows relevance hurts on GQA/POPE, undercutting the prompt-aware claim
Per-benchmark k tuned on the test set (oracle), weakening the zero-shot claim and the fairness of the DivPrune comparison
Implausible baseline numbers (LLaVA-1.5 AI2D 29.1, MMMU test split, ChartQA +22.7% from pruning) suggest an unreliable evaluation pipeline; no variance or significance testing
Weak efficiency analysis and narrow scope: one model/benchmark for latency, slower than DivPrune, image-only, single 90% ratio
